📅 Your financial week ahead: 9 to 15 November

🇿🇦 MZANSI
🗳️ Sunday 8 Nov: the IEC declares the official local election results. Coalition talks start in the hung councils, and those deals decide who sets your rates and tariffs.
👷 Tuesday 10 Nov: Stats SA's new unemployment figures for July to September. Last quarter it was 33.6%.
🏭 Thursday 12 Nov: mining and factory output for September, a check on jobs and growth.
⛽ All week: mid-month fuel data points to December pump prices.
🔜 Next week: inflation (18 Nov) and the Reserve Bank's rate decision (19 Nov).

🌍 THE REST OF THE WORLD
🇨🇳 Monday: China's inflation and, on Tuesday, its trade figures. China is one of our biggest trading partners.
🇺🇸 Tuesday: US inflation for October. The one to watch: a high number can strengthen the dollar and weaken the rand, which feeds into petrol prices.
🇬🇧 Thursday: UK economic growth for July to September.
🇮🇳 Thursday: India's inflation.
🇺🇸 Friday: US producer prices.
🇯🇵 Monday 16 Nov: Japan's economic growth figures.

💱 The rand ended last week at about R16.52 to the US dollar.

Which number matters most to your pocket this week? 👇
